entities.name: Itzama the Crested
entities.description: A Sun Empire speaker who guides others and warns against sailors and foul presences.

entities.name: Huatli
entities.description: A Sun Empire warrior who speaks of the sun's strength, coatls and the hunt.

entities.name: Adrian Adanto of Lujio
entities.description: A Legion of Dusk speaker who claims land for the queen.

entities.name: Mavren Fein
entities.description: A vampire who steered a ship to shore by faith alone during his Blood Fast.

entities.name: Chitlati
entities.description: A Lightning Rider who speaks of the rays of the three sun aspects.

entities.name: Jace Beleren
entities.description: A planeswalker who awoke on Ixalan certain he was lost and examines the thaumatic compass.

entities.name: High Marshal Arguel
entities.description: A vampire leader of the Legion of Dusk whose vision led him to the temple of Aclazotz.

entities.name: Caparocti Sunborn
entities.description: A Sun Empire speaker who says aerosaurs hide in the noonday sun.

entities.name: Captain Brandis Thorn
entities.description: A pirate captain who adds ships to his fleet by offering the crew a choice to follow him or fall in the sea.

entities.name: Captain Parrish
entities.description: A pirate captain who plunders secrets rather than treasure.

entities.name: Shaper Tuvasa
entities.description: A River Heralds shaper who speaks of the water between the two halves of the world.

entities.name: Captain Lannery Storm
entities.description: A pirate captain who takes the more dangerous route and sails for adventure.

entities.name: Kumena
entities.description: A merfolk shaper who realized he must claim the hidden city's power for himself.

entities.name: Vraska
entities.description: A planeswalker and pirate captain with a will of stone who can turn people to stone; she tried for the first time to prevent death.

entities.name: Nicol Bolas
entities.description: The one who gave Vraska a thaumatic compass.

entities.name: Captain Brinely Rage
entities.description: A pirate captain who remarks on the ground running and nature rising against them.

entities.name: Shaper Pashona
entities.description: A shaper haunted by visions of the world's end brought by the search for the Immortal Sun.

entities.name: Shaper Falani
entities.description: A shaper who speaks of the breath shared between the Deeproot and the jungle.

entities.name: Viceroy Elia Sotonores
entities.description: A viceroy who reports to the queen on a ruthless conquistador.

entities.name: Amautl
entities.description: A knight of Atzocan who speaks of horncrests.

entities.name: Grick Doobin
entities.description: A pirate whose last words warned of a storm on the horizon.

entities.name: Emperor Apatzec Intli III
entities.description: The emperor of the Sun Empire who speaks of great wings.

entities.name: Vona
entities.description: A vampire who has led armies of conquest for four hundred years.

entities.name: Admiral Beckett Brass
entities.description: An admiral who invites a captain to join her fleet.

entities.name: Angrath
entities.description: A planeswalker trapped on Ixalan as a minotaur pirate captain who cares more for mayhem than treasure.

entities.name: Ripley Vance
entities.description: A captain who commands the Spitfire Bastion instead of a ship.

entities.name: Elenda
entities.description: The first vampire, whose vows nobles take in the Rite of Redemption.

entities.name: Venerable Tarrian
entities.description: A figure whose lance was once wielded by a Legion lancer.

entities.name: Kinjalli
entities.description: The Wakening Sun, an aspect of the Sun Empire's sun worship who created humans from clay and baked them in the sun's warmth.

entities.name: Tilonalli
entities.description: The Burning Sun, associated with ferocity, fire and passion.

entities.name: Ixalli
entities.description: The Verdant Sun, who fosters growth in all things.

entities.name: Aclazotz
entities.description: A bat-god of night, eternal enemy of the Threefold Sun, with a lost temple in the jungle.

entities.name: Threefold Sun
entities.description: The sun worshiped by the Sun Empire in three aspects: Kinjalli, Tilonalli and Ixalli.

entities.name: Sun Empire
entities.description: A realm of sun worshipers that tests humans against dinosaurs and was driven from the forest by the Deeproot.

entities.name: Legion of Dusk
entities.description: A vampire army that sailed from Torrezon seeking glory, riches and the Immortal Sun.

entities.name: Church of Dusk
entities.description: A vampire church that teaches there is no gain without loss.

entities.name: Sanctum Seekers
entities.description: The first of the knightly orders to cross the sea and the most zealous.

entities.name: Order of the Bloodstained
entities.description: A paladin order closely linked to the Church of Dusk and devout to fanaticism.

entities.name: River Heralds
entities.description: Merfolk who carve spells into jade and fight to keep others from the golden city.

entities.name: Brazen Coalition
entities.description: The pirates descended from those displaced by the Legion of Dusk, eager for vengeance.

entities.name: Deadeye Fleet
entities.description: A pirate fleet of noble heritage known for underhanded tactics.

entities.name: Dire Fleet
entities.description: A pirate fleet of orcs under captains who steer toward battle.

entities.name: Storm Fleet
entities.description: A pirate fleet that values the freedom of sky and sea.

entities.name: Fathom Fleet
entities.description: A pirate fleet whose captain invites others to take the world.

entities.name: Deeproot
entities.description: The people of the forest who drove the Sun Empire out long ago and guard the jungle.

entities.name: Torrezon
entities.description: The homeland of the vampires, the old noble class guided by church and crown.

entities.name: Pachatupa
entities.description: The glorious city at the center of the Sun Empire.

entities.name: Tocatli
entities.description: The emperor's palace, the glowing heart of Pachatupa.

entities.name: High and Dry
entities.description: A floating city of pirates offering rest, recreation and revenge.

entities.name: Queen's Bay
entities.description: The site of Legion of Dusk colonies.

entities.name: Great River
entities.description: The river into which nine rivers flow, guarded by the River Heralds.

entities.name: Spitfire Bastion
entities.description: The fortress Ripley Vance commands.

entities.name: Itlimoc
entities.description: Where humans and merfolk joined their magic before the Sun Empire was born.

entities.name: Stormwreck Sea
entities.description: A sea where ships trapped in unmelting ice.

entities.name: Atzocan
entities.description: A place of which Amautl is a knight.

entities.name: Orazca
entities.description: The city of gold and its Spires, called a cryptic objective.

entities.name: Azcanta
entities.description: The Sunken Ruin that houses all the learning of a long-forgotten age.

entities.name: Ixalan
entities.description: The plane on which the story takes place.

entities.name: Immortal Sun
entities.description: An artifact the Legion of Dusk seeks for true eternal life.

entities.name: Thaumatic Compass
entities.description: A compass Bolas gave Vraska, also examined by Jace.

entities.name: Rite of Redemption
entities.description: A rite in which nobles take Elenda's vows and make the eternal sacrifice.

entities.name: Blood Fast
entities.description: A vampire rite whose end in hunger brings sudden, explosive violence.

events.summary: Jace awakes on Ixalan certain that he is lost.
events.quote: Jace awoke to the certainty that he was lost.

events.summary: Mavren Fein steers a ship to shore by faith alone during his Blood Fast.
events.quote: In the rapture of his Blood Fast, he destroyed the navigator's tools and steered the ship to shore by faith alone.

events.summary: The Legion of Dusk sails from Torrezon seeking glory, riches and the Immortal Sun.
events.quote: The Legion of Dusk sailed from Torrezon in search of glory, riches, and the Immortal Sun.

events.summary: Adrian Adanto claims land for the queen.
events.quote: I claim this land in the name of the queen.

events.summary: Kumena realizes he must claim the hidden city's power for himself.
events.quote: The truth came to Kumena like the Great River's torrent: the only way to keep his enemies away from the hidden city was to claim its power for himself.

events.summary: Vraska tries for the first time in her life to prevent death.
events.quote: For the first time in her life, Vraska tried to prevent death.

events.summary: Following Bolas's compass, Vraska blunders into the River Heralds' trap.
events.quote: Carefully following the thaumatic compass Bolas had given her, Vraska blundered straight into the River Heralds' trap.

events.summary: Arguel's vision leads him into the jungles of Ixalan to the lost temple of Aclazotz.
events.quote: Arguel's vision led him into the jungles of Ixalan . . .

events.summary: Vraska's reputation as a captain who turns people to stone spreads through High and Dry.
events.quote: It wasn't long before the taverns of High and Dry were full of whispers about the new captain who could turn a person to stone with a glance.

events.summary: Captain Vance carves the cliffs with a broadside to form her new home.
events.quote: With a broadside assault, Captain Vance carved the cliffs to form her new home.

events.summary: The Legion of Dusk builds up its fort walls just in time for pirates to burn them down.
events.quote: Wary of the ferocious dinosaurs, the Legion of Dusk built up the walls of their fort—just in time for the pirates to burn them down.

events.summary: Before the Sun Empire, humans and merfolk join their magic to bless the land with fertility.
events.quote: Before the Sun Empire was born, humans and merfolk joined their magic to invoke a blessing of fertility on the land.

events.summary: Pirates venture into the interior for treasure and find something far greater.
events.quote: The pirates had ventured into the interior for treasure. They found something far greater.

events.summary: The planeswalker Angrath, trapped on Ixalan, captures ships but cannot break free.
events.quote: Trapped on Ixalan, the Planeswalker Angrath is the only minotaur sailing the seas.

events.summary: The Legion's conquistadors surround a dinosaur only to find it has outflanked them.
events.quote: The conquistadors surrounded the dinosaur only to find that it had outflanked them.

events.summary: Captain Brinely Rage sees nature rise against them.
events.quote: It appears that nature has risen against us.

events.summary: Jace examines the thaumatic compass, which points to a cryptic objective.
